job: Inhibit K3 while either low-voltage analog supply is below threshold; preserve the existing user reverb latch and reset priority.

interface.comparator: TI LM393P PDIP-8, socket required; powered by +12V/GND
interface.connections: Both open collectors join REV_GATE. Comparator A compares PSENSE(+) with PREF(-). Comparator B compares NREF(+) with NSENSE(-). R341 proposal is 4.7k; existing R342 stays100k. No independent pull-up bypasses REV_Q.

negative_clamp: Schottky anode GND, cathode CLAMP; split divider attenuates negative clamp voltage before NSENSE. Exact diode not selected.
limitations: Gate high bound and sink current require full circuit proof
Clamp allocation is not an exact-diode guarantee
Total resistor tolerance must include temperature and life effects before release
No startup/release timing or pop qualification
Existing +5V supervisor limits remain an independent open item
No manufacturing or exact resistor sourcing approval
gate_high_basis: Provisional lower bound using the existing HC74 3.84V VOH guarantee, 4.7k series resistance and combined feedback/pulldown loading; validate full DC network and output leakage.
datasheet_correction: TI SLCS005AH p8: full-range IIB magnitude400nA, IIO250nA; conservative independent input magnitude525nA =400+250/2. Full-range VOL700mV; prior250nA/400mV were room-temperature values. No candidate was native.
